description: Links one identity at the identity provider (issuer and subject) to one Frappe user. The pair is the permanent key of the user. The e-mail address is only contact data and may change.

fields.description: Identity provider address as written in the token's iss claim, for example https://idp.example.test/realms/platform. Together with Subject it is unique.
fields.label: Issuer

fields.description: Stable user identifier at the identity provider (the sub claim). Together with Issuer it is unique. It never changes when the e-mail changes.
fields.label: Subject

fields.description: The Frappe user this identity signs in as. One user has at most one link.
fields.label: User

name: Platform Identity Link
